Zoe: Quick flag - between 09:12-09:18 UTC a small number of onboarding uploads showed 'partial indexed' and some attachments didn't appear. I'm pulling the affected tenant list now.

infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-210. Retry job queued.

Zoe: Early affected: TrialSpark-5, RetailPro-2 (renewal in 10 days), CampusStart-1. Marcus can you mark retail as high-touch?

Marcus (AE): Marking RetailPro-2 high-touch. Renewal next week  please offer stronger remediation. I'll take the outreach.

Priya (CS): Thanks. Root cause prelim: transient writer backpressure after a config push; retries are running and queue is draining. SRE suggests avoid technical detail externally.

Zoe: Draft external short (trials): "Hi <Name>, we experienced brief delays processing uploads between 09:12-09:18 UTC which may have affected some items. We've retried pending uploads and prioritized impacted accounts. We're sorry for the inconvenience  we'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute recovery session and a one-time 5% credit. If you still see missing items reply and we'll manually re-ingest."

Priya (CS): Draft high-touch (RetailPro-2): "Hi <Name>, apologies  we prioritized your uploads after a brief processing issue and retried pending items. To make this right we'd like to offer one month of premium support or a billing credit, plus a 30-minute technical sync with our team. Please let us know which you prefer and a good time."

Marcus (AE): Approved. Please include billing tag "incident-credit-1758888444" so finance can track. Add a line offering a direct calendaring link for the technical sync.

Zoe: Will send high-touch to RetailPro-2 now, broadcast trials in 20m after queue fully drains. Opening office hours for recovery: Wed 11am PT / Thu 4pm CET.

infra-bot: retry job progress: 73% drained. Logs attached to INC-2026-210.

Priya (CS): I'll capture responses in the CS tracker and escalate any manual re-ingest requests. We'll summarize feedback into the incident RCA. Update execs by EOD. :thumbsup:
